title: Xi thanks Kim for 'fruitful' summit: KCNA
snippet: KCNA reported that Xi Jinping sent a thank-you letter to Kim Jong Un calling the summit 'fruitful'. Xi said the two leaders exchanged views 'in-depth' and reached 'important common understanding' on shared concerns, adding 'new substance' to bilateral relations. Xi described the relationship as entering 'a new historical journey' and expressed readiness to consolidate and develop ties and advance the socialist cause of both countries.
